## Highlights

- New: play a short audio preview of any track right from the playlist view, without leaving the app or opening YouTube Music.

## New and improved

- Each track now shows a "Preview" button alongside "Open in YouTube Music" whenever a short audio clip is available for it; tracks without a match keep today's "Open in YouTube Music" behavior unchanged.

## Upgrade notes

- No action required. Existing settings, favorites and playlist data carry over automatically.
